proposition: In a letter of ca. 817/1415 Yazdī congratulated Ibn Turka on finishing his commentary on the Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam and promised to accompany him to Khurasan and the shrine at Mashhad.

mediation.who: Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī (?), to Ibn Turka
mediation.note: Found only in MS Sinā 316, whose colophon is late; MK marks the letter's date and place with '?'.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
